metadata.title: BI Dashboard Extensions Platform Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed as Tableau dashboard and viz extensions (Tableau Cloud SaaS hosting, Tableau Server safelisting, Tableau Desktop, the Tableau Exchange), as Power BI custom visuals on Microsoft AppSource and Looker Studio community visualizations, as the Enterprise self-hosted runtime (Windows one-click installer, Linux install, ExtensionsManager admin console, WriteBackExtreme and MailScheduler servers), to the Infotopics web portals, to delivery channels and APIs (email, Teams, Slack, network drives, REST APIs, database connectors) and to internal operations tooling. Extension front-ends appear both in the SaaS channel and in the self-hosted channel. Each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: The primary runtime: extensions built on the Tableau Extensions API and Viz Extensions, loaded inside Tableau Cloud, Tableau Server and Tableau Desktop dashboards from a safelisted URL, and discovered through the Tableau Exchange listing.

Infotopics-hosted extension web apps used by Free, Professional and Enterprise SaaS customers on Tableau Cloud; the extension runs in the dashboard, the license service counts anonymous unique users over a rolling 12 months.
